operation: After nonlinear patch failure, compile the full cubic bulk residual into polynomial coefficients and its A0 inverse Gram matrix. Split arbitrary changed cohesive-seam topology as a supported residual, keeping its cross term with bulk. Query Newton and residual energy certificate require neither global state reconstruction nor global solve.
model: Exactly the extension's nx64 ny32 beta20 convex bulk, strain .1 and supplied frozen cohesive preload history. Nonlinear biological and evolving cohesive branch certification remain UNKNOWN.
executed_tier_policy: Execute tier1; if any residual acceptance fails, execute independently preregistered tier2 acquisitions in the same round. Do not use heldout full solutions to choose or update basis.
query: Full-rank basis from training full states via SVD. Reduced nonlinear Newton. r=C v(z)+B s(z,cut); residual norm squared v^T H v+2 s^T D v+s^T G s, H=C^T A0^-1 C, D=B^T A0^-1 C, G=B^T A0^-1 B. Preserve the signed cross term. Seam kappa / cut support changes require no cubic coefficient rebuild.
arithmetic: Add a disclosed binary64 evaluation allowance based on absolute contractions to norm squared. This is an engineering bound, not verified outward interval arithmetic. Exact-arithmetic discrete monotonicity theorem is separate.
control: Same-information polynomial intrusive Galerkin / reduced-basis residual Gram certifier is mathematically identical: TIE. Uniform full nonlinear FE remains a measured cost comparator, with its reusable sparse control eligible.
costs: Charge basis acquisitions, polynomial coefficient construction, all global RHS solves for Gram, fitting, validation and fallback. Warm accepted queries only are reported separately, and all queries include fallbacks in end-to-end accounting.
falsifier: Certificate exceeds budget, polynomial identity differs, omitted seam/bulk cross term falsely accepts, or the equally informed conventional certifier matches
